sources.title: Weak gravity (and other conjectures) with broken supersymmetry

evidence.text: Numerically integrate the radius equations forward and backward using Runge–Kutta. sources.title: Why do we live in 3+1 dimensions?

sources.title: Brane gas cosmology in M theory: Late time behavior

evidence.text: Derive the smeared brane stress tensor from the Nambu–Goto action and combine it with radiation in the Einstein equations. With λi=log(2πRi), the evolution resembles motion with friction Vdot/V, a common positive expansion force and a nonpositive wrapping-dependent force.

sources.title: Brane gas cosmology in M theory: Late time behavior

evidence.text: Use the late-time ansatz 2πRi=ai t^α, bi t^β or ci t^γ for the three wrapping classes. Balance powers of time and solve algebraic coefficient equations. Four sectors distinguish whether radiation and full–full wrapping contributions remain important.
